reviews.review: Definitely a good game. Awesome visuals, variety of flavors of destruction, and a decent teamwork mechanic. The game in general has a bit of a learning curve though so be prepared to spend a few hours figuring out maneuvers, why other people can throw fireballs and you can't, etc. XD

I have played it for 3 days now. Recreating my review.

This game has a bittersweet taste of fun and pay. At first it feels like you have to pay for everything, but after some time playing it, I've found out that you can get probably every item you could buy with real money, or the ingame currency "Platinum" which is bough with real money, also with just some time. And that is the real reason to play this game. It's not really about killing every boss or playing every mission or getting every achievement. It's about spending time ingame. And for me, playing this game, is getting new warframes and crafting new weapons. And after getting them, leveling them is the next part. But as lovely as it is to play this game, it's also a bit annoying that you can only have 4 warframes at a time without spending a single coin. And spending money in this game makes me kinda angry. There is an online rating for the ingame currency "Platinum", which says that 75 Platinum is around 5$.
Most Warframes cost around 225 Platinum and some of the cooler ones cost 375. Most of the Warframes are gainable through resource gathering and buying the Blueprints for them with Credits (The other, ingame gainable, currency in Warframe). One problem there is, you only have 4 Warframes slots if you don't want to pay for this game. That means, you can have 4 Warframes at a time, while players who pay can have a pile of them. The game is called Warframe, why would you do this with the items the game is called after? I'd prefer a way to gain these slots ingame.

All in all is this game a nice longtime game with a lot of cooperation between players. The community is nice aswell. Hell you can even ask them if they taxi you to a mission you don't have access yet.

I will keep playing this game and might aswell put some money into it to get more Warframe slots.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
EDIT:

I have played the game on and off for about 3 years now. I can't believe how much it changed my opinion. This game isn't good anymore.
It's amazingly great.

I have not put a single coin into the game and yet got all of the games character classes (called Warframes). But I probably should have given something to Digital Extremes (foollowing only DE) for their great work.

I haven't found a game I could appreciate for such an exhaustingly long time. A game which caught me everytime I picked it up again. A game created with the love only a (space)mom could have. If you happen to just grab the game because it's free, look around. Look at the detail in every aspect of the game. And remember it well. Because if you pick it up again after some years. This game will still be able to amaze you with the amount of detail. Not only talking graphics here. Storywise the game is a masterpiece. And the ingame mechanics are kept fresh.

DE is doing a great job with this game. It's for me, as a gamer who likes to play the ♥♥♥♥ out of one game he enjoys, the greatest honor to call myself a space ninja.

But i only took the DevTeam in for some sugar blowing. I have to give it to the community aswell. If you have played Rust, League of Legends or the like, DayZ you probably don't have a good feeling when you hear the word "community" and if you like association games the first word your mind is trying to yell out is "TOXIC". If you take a sip of the delicious refreshing brew the ingame chat is and talk a little to the people ingame you will find a kindness never found anywhere else on the internet. The big community around the Twitch streamers. Around the DevTeam with their DevBlogs on Twitch. It's amazing how much LOVE there is to be spread.

If you ever tried games like Tribes:Ascend or Heroes&Generals (and my mates will know that I tried those. For hours. Yea, call me out I don't care) you probably had a lot of fun some years ago. When the games were still good.
This game stays good. It's the loved child of a company that is still caring. DE loves their playerbase, check it out on the devstreams. And they don't want to let anyone down. This company is open and friendly with the players. Check Steve's Tweets (Steve Sinclair "Video Game Director @DigitalExtremes." <- not obviously copied from his Twitter) and see for yourself how much he cares. He tweeted about a feature(*1). Someone asked for an addition to that feature and Steve just said "Yep ok we will.". Like, what the hell man? You can just write some request to the VG Director of a company, mind it: ON TWITTER, and he just says that? Try it with EA. No reaction? Guessed so.

I really enjoy this game, the community, the story, the music, the voice acting and everything around this game. And I can tell you already: I will keep enjoying it until something bad happens.

Let's Lift together.
Thanks for reading.
